if [ -e "$D" ]; then echo REFUSE_EXISTING_SCRATCH; exit 90; fi
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$D" -- --quiet
git -C "$D" checkout -q chatgpt-gpt56sol-omega-current-final-convergence-20260913

test "$HEAD" = 2769d5b4de6c27c087913ddc68569e10363ef21b

python3 -m py_compile scripts/voice_777_runtime.py scripts/voice_full_runtime.py scripts/omega_arm_bus.py scripts/voice777_local_audio_arm.py scripts/voice777_pocket_renderer.py scripts/voice777_omni_presence.py

PYTHONPATH="$PWD/scripts" FRANK_OMEGA_FINAL_SCRIPTS=/tmp/omega777-missing-final-policy FRANK_OMEGA_REQUIRE_FINAL=1 python3 -c 'import voice_777_runtime' >/tmp/omega777-pr84-missing.out 2>/tmp/omega777-pr84-missing.err
